# std.lru

<!-- Generated by `badger doc std` from the checked interfaces (badger 0.1.0). Do not edit by hand. -->

Least-recently-used caches: at most `capacity` entries; adding one more
evicts the entry used longest ago. `get` counts as a use (and so returns
the cache with that use recorded); `peek` does not. Operations take
O(log n) and return a new cache, leaving the old one unchanged; keep the
current one in an `Atom` or a `var` to share it.

    var c = lru.cache<String, Int>(2).put("a", 1).put("b", 2)
    let (hit, c2) = c.get("a")        // .some(1); "a" is now the newest
    c2.put("c", 3).contains("b")      // false: "b" was evicted
